quest.title: Heart of Amrita
quest.description: Farther inside the Vourukasha Oasis, a mysterious Pari is waiting for you...

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Hello there, are you the outlander offerer they spoke of?

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Yes, I have heard of a valiant human who is bonded to a Pari. It has been centuries since this land last witnessed something so wondrous!

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: We Pari used to walk with humans, and we would both build our homes in this Vourukasha Oasis.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Despite the threat of the darkness, its corrosion never once stained the Oasis thanks to the protection of the Harvisptokhm and Khvarena.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Though centuries have passed, those years remain my most cherished memories.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: I'm in charge of looking after the Amrita Pool. I have not set foot outside this place since Lady Zurvan sealed the Oasis.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: The Amrita Pool is where we Pari were granted life. In it flows the primordial water left behind by our god.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: It's all thanks to the Amrita that countless motes of Khvarena have gained power and life.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: We will turn into Plumes of Purifying Light after exhausting our strength, leaving behind nothing but pure memories.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: And memories that belong to the Khvarena will return to the Harvisptokhm through the Amrita Pool.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: The Amrita is all that is needed to wash away the deepest sadness and sorrow. With its nourishment, one shall regain their pristine form as the Khvarena's familiar.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: And the offerer is the one who will help those familiars of Khvarena return to the sea of flowers.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: But ever since human warriors ceased performing that duty, Pari who have drained their strength while resisting the defilement have not been able to return to the sea of flowers.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: Fortunately, now that we've been visited by a human warrior once again, the scattered Plumes of Purifying Light shall return to this place eventually.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: The Amrita Pool will accept all remembrances so long as an offering is made, and the waters and the tree will bestow blessings upon you.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: This is also the mercy of the divine.

response.speaker: Fedhri
response.text: I can feel that you are indeed the one who has forged a Lau{RUBY#[S]connection}pa with a Pari.
